summary: Black Diamond Experts is an Established (Digital Maturity 73) HVAC/plumbing/electric contractor in Salt Lake City with exceptional reputation (4.8/6483 reviews) and strong site fundamentals (SEO 100, Accessibility 100, 0/50 broken links). Deterministic audit flags a single priority issue: Enquiry friction - 'The first website form asks for many details at once.' Measured homepage shows 34 inputs across 2 forms and 134 internal links may dilute primary action. Best opportunity is staged form simplification, not platform migration.

topOpportunities.title: Reduce initial form friction
topOpportunities.evidence: Deterministic finding: 'The first website form asks for many details at once' + homepageSignals inputCount: 34 across forms: 2
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Long first forms correlate with abandonment; shortening first step can increase completion without losing qualification data collected after intent.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Reduce initial enquiry to 3-5 fields (name, phone, zip/service needed) and move 34-field detail to step 2/confirmed booking. Test on homepage and /contact-us/customer-service/ (also 34 inputs) before rolling to /hvac-services/ templates (17 inputs).

topOpportunities.title: Prioritize primary booking CTA hierarchy
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage CTA phrases detected: 9 and internal links observed on homepage: 134
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: 134 internal links and 9 competing CTAs can distract from the booking action detected; clear hierarchy focuses user toward online booking link already present.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Establish single primary CTA ('Book Online' / 'Get Estimate') with sticky header + above-fold button, demote secondary links to footer/secondary nav. Reduce competing CTAs from 9 to 2-3 distinct actions.

topOpportunities.title: Surface reputation proof at point of enquiry
topOpportunities.evidence: Business has 4.8 rating from 6483 reviews and 96% four- and five-star share with structured data found
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Trust signal is already earned but not necessarily visible at friction point; placing proven 6483-review strength next to shortened form may offset hesitation.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add review and schema proof near primary form: show total count, rating, and recent review date near booking CTA. Ensure LocalBusiness + AggregateRating schema is validated for SLC location.

topOpportunities.title: Validate performance and content density
topOpportunities.evidence: Crawled 10 same-site pages with wordCount 11216-12307 per page and h1Count 1 on each; Lighthouse status Failed due to CHROME_PATH not set
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Very long pages may dilute conversions and performance not yet measured; confirming load speed ensures friction fix isn't undermined by slow mobile rendering.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Keep template structure but tighten service page copy and re-run full performance audit (performance and best practices were not measured) to check mobile load with 26 images despite altCoverage 100% and mobileQuality Good.
